ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central black contiguous region bifurcating into the notch; flanked by high-intensity white lobes. High-frequency black stippling/mottling present in the transition zone on the left lobe; more sparse, isolated black clusters present on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 105 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical bounding box of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern; left lobe trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude peaks (approx. 2-5 pixels); right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks (approx. 5-12 pixels) particularly adjacent to the notch area.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on the outer leading edges; the trailing edge exhibits a slight S-curve convexity transitioning to concavity near the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of irregular circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at both distal fluke tips; approximately 15-20 distinct units on the left tip and 10-15 on the right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct parallel vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) observed on the mid-left lobe white field; one diagonal linear disruption observed on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization on both fluke terminals; multiple vertical rake marks on the left ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The heavy concentration of barnacles specifically at the extreme tips creating a distinct bulbous silhouette at the terminals.
